sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lei Dang is a story encounter in Mirage Estate, found at Mirage Estate. Beating it yields Tiger Cannon.

Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not run an elemental damage system, so there is no weakness table to fill in - nothing here is estimated from how a boss looks, which is exactly how wrong weakness tables get written.

What the game does have is a colour language on enemy attacks, and it is the single most useful thing to learn: a red flash marks an unblockable attack that must be dodged, a blue flash marks a parryable one that should be deflected, and a purple flash means the boss has just parried you and a counter is coming. See the combat system for how Sha-Chi feeds into this.

sections.title: How to Beat the Lei Dang
sections.content:
What works

  • Two phases - the second changes his attack set, so spend phase one learning tells rather than racing the bar.
  • The Tiger Cannon is the reward, and it is worth the two attempts this fight usually takes.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: This page tracks the Lei Dang in Phantom Blade Zero, released October 29, 2026. Location, drops and tactics are filled from the shipped game and from published fight guides; anything still marked “not confirmed post-launch” has not been confirmed by any source we could check.
